title: The Diplomatic Pouch: 3,000 cr once from Sol Central, 5 gold ore bought at Haven, accepted at Sol and delivered to Central Nexus (a paid way home from Haven)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-24 06:43 UTC (orders ENT-085 block APOLLO and P1: no hauler waits docked; rules F8, F12, F34). The Diplomatic Pouch (Sol Central's board, template the_diplomatic_pouch): deliver_item gold_ore x5 at central_nexus, 3,000 cr, Piloting 220, trading 20, navigation 15. The mission hands out no gold on accept (accept by hand at Sol, 06:18 UTC: the hold stayed empty), so the gold is bought: Haven asks 40 x 107 (table books this turn; Sol asks 30 x 1 only). Bought goods meet a deliver_item objective: Gathering the Old Charts paid with 5 boards bought at Sol (06:40 UTC). Never gold of the reserve (rule F24). For haulers at Haven: those that finished the Federation Trade Route Prospectus or carried Courier to Haven there. Haven -> Sol 14 jumps, Sol -> Nexus Prime 10 (table lanes). The accept carries needs: no gold aboard, no accept, and the tour stops at Sol. 2026-11-24 06:56 UTC (Apollo): max_ships 21 -> 45 and max_price 60 -> 80 (3,000 cr pays gold well above the 40 ask; the book's depth 3,051 lies at prices not read); stop_on_failed_buy on the Haven stop, so a pilot that buys no gold ends there instead of flying to Sol for nothing.
